sourceChanges.reason: The rendered tapered CylinderGeometry already has bottom radius 1.05*r. Only its per-column X/Z collider footprint grows from r to 1.05*r; mesh, height, placement and all walkables remain exact.

Add a visible reversible nonhistoric low-headroom guard, with one thin collision proxy per rendered bar/post, to each Baoxiang and Ciyin flight. No invisible stair-volume fill; no change to support ramp.

Baoxiang-only smaller maximum step rise increases tread/riser/guard segmentation for real body headroom. Tread geometry and guard proxies change; walkRamp endpoints and all other towers are unaffected by this source edit.

Move only the two Baoxiang bottom-run endpoints. The existing derived stair holes and upper floor subdivision follow those endpoints, as do the two physical walk ramps; top landings, six lightwells and end-door partitions are retained.
The 4 cabinet/niche frameworks already contain 5 horizontal and 6 vertical visible grid members each. Enable one existing-member proxy for each of 44 bars; do not alter their rendered geometry.

Adjust only Baoxiang actual built.g.navigation.stairRoutes bottom approach waypoints to the fitted safe entry approach. The legacy helper hashes p.navigation, not this built route; the supplemental actual-navigation test closes that gap.

Add visible reversible nonhistoric guard bars and posts below the two Wenyuan fitted flights. Each mesh gets its matching thin proxy; existing stair treads, ramps, floor holes and level geometry remain exact.
Enable a thin matching proxy for each of the 5 already visible ground-photo screen rails, without changing screen posts, mesh geometry or historical claims.

Retain every inherited door leaf, beam, column, wall/window and upstairs enclosure mesh exactly. Add only each eligible rendered component AABB, with 0.05 m downward margin solely for caihua_beam head trim, and skip at/below floor plus STEP_UP. No aggregate roof/room/furniture box.
